title: Logged-model trace pages: metrics hooks must receive the same scope as row queries
answers: assessment counts on logged model traces page show wrong percentages
categorical assessment summary counts whole experiment instead of model
logged model traces tab shows True 50% from other model's traces
count badge on logged model Traces page includes traces from other models
body:
Symptom: On a logged model's Traces page, categorical assessment summaries (e.g. True/False percentages) and count badges include traces from other logged models in the same experiment, even though the visible rows are filtered to the selected model.
Root cause: mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/components/experiment-page/components/traces-v3/TracesV3Logs.tsx:TracesV3LogsImpl passed loggedModelId to row/metadata queries but not to useAssessmentCountMetrics or useCountInfo, so the metrics endpoint ran experiment-wide.
Fix pattern: Pass loggedModelId into useCountInfo and useAssessmentCountMetrics alongside runUuid and timeRange; each hook appends a trace metadata filter on mlflow.modelId to the metrics request filters.
Constraints: Any new scope (run, model, time range) applied to Traces V3 row queries must also be passed to every metrics-backed hook in the same component, or counts will silently diverge from visible rows. Does not apply to row search, which uses its own request_metadata filter format.
applies: Traces V3 logs view under experiment-page/components/traces-v3, used on experiment and logged model pages.
says: The traces tab for a model displays assessment percentages from other models.
Trace count badges on the model page do not match the displayed rows.
Filter assessment summary metrics to the selected model instead of the whole experiment.
Categorical evaluation counts on the model traces screen include unrelated run data.
search: In TracesV3LogsImpl, metrics hooks useCountInfo and useAssessmentCountMetrics must receive the loggedModelId scope alongside runUuid and timeRange. Without this scope filter on mlflow.modelId, assessment percentage summaries and count badges aggregate experiment-wide traces instead of filtering to the active logged model. Every scope applied to Traces V3 row queries must also be passed to all metrics-backed hooks in the component to prevent counts from diverging from visible rows. This constraint applies to metrics requests rather than row search queries, which use their own request_metadata filter format.
